title: PCR Prep - Plate Filling
author: Opentrons
materials: This protocol automates the creation of a PCR Plate with a variable number of samples. Using the [Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/tube-rack-set-1) with [2mL Eppendorf tubes](https://labware.opentrons.com/opentrons_24_tuberack_eppendorf_2ml_safelock_snapcap?category=tubeRack), 20µL of pre-made master mix is added to PCR Plate. Following the addition of master mix to all necessary wells, 5µL of water is added for the negative control and 5µL of each sample is added to the other well(s). If you have any questions about this protocol, please email our Applications Engineering team at [protocols@opentrons.com](mailto:protocols@opentrons.com). --- To purchase tips, reagents, or pipettes, please visit our [online store](https://shop.opentrons.com/) or contact our sales team at [info@opentrons.com](mailto:info@opentrons.com) * [Opentrons OT-2](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/ot-2) * [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.21.0 or later)](https://opentrons.com/ot-app/) * [Opentrons P20 Single-Channel Pipette](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/ot-2-robot/products/single-channel-electronic-pipette) * [Opentrons 20µL Filter Tip Rack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips) * [Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/tube-rack-set-1) * [Bio-Rad 96-Well PCR Plate, 200µL](https://labware.opentrons.com/biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr?category=wellPlate) * Eppendorf 2mL Tubes * Master Mix * Negative Control (Water) * Samples --- **Deck Layout** **Slot 1**: [Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/verified-labware/products/tube-rack-set-1) containing Samples (1-24) **Slot 2**: [Bio-Rad 96-Well PCR Plate, 200µL](https://labware.opentrons.com/biorad_96_wellplate_200ul_pcr?category=wellPlate) (Final PCR Plate) **Slot 3**: [Opentrons 4-in-1 Tube Rack](https
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Download the provided protocol file to your computer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons OT App and upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck as follows: Slot 1 – Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack containing up to 24 samples in 2 mL Eppendorf tubes; Slot 2 – Bio‑Rad 96‑well PCR plate (200 µL); Slot 3 – Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack (e.g., for tips or reagents).

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the deck, tip racks, and the P20 single‑channel pipette according to the on‑screen instructions.

steps.title: Run PCR plate filling
steps.instruction: Execute the protocol; the robot will add 20 µL of pre‑made master mix to each required well, then add 5 µL of water to the negative‑control well, and finally add 5 µL of each sample to its designated well(s).

substeps.instruction: Add 20 µL master mix to all required wells
Add 5 µL water to the negative‑control well
Add 5 µL of each sample to the remaining well(s)
